name: @chewygumxx/skill-managing-worktrunk-worktrees
description: Manages Git worktrees and their setup with the Worktrunk `wt` CLI. Use when a task calls for `wt switch`, `wt list`, `wt merge`, or `wt remove`, or for Worktrunk shell integration, `.config/wt.toml` hooks and approvals, aliases, ignored-file copying, or LLM commits.
